title: Кровотечение
motif: One large solid hanging teardrop of blood, pointed top and wide rounded bottom. Single closed outline; NO wound, splashes or extra droplets.

title: Горение
motif: One large upright flame with three broad tongues, the central tongue tallest. Solid flat shape, one large simple inner cutout only if needed. NO floor or base.

title: Яд
motif: One large front-facing skull with a broad rounded cranium and short squared jaw. Exactly two large hollow eye sockets, no nose, no teeth, no crossbones.

title: Кислота
motif: One large droplet falling onto a short horizontal metal slab with a single large eaten-away semicircular bite directly beneath the drop. Only drop and corroded slab, no bubbles.

title: Оглушение
motif: One large asymmetric seven-point impact starburst, bold jagged comic stun spark. No face, no head, no other stars, no inner mark.

title: Путы
motif: Two simple short booted legs tightly bound together by ONE thick rope loop across the ankles. Only two legs and one broad loop, no individual rope strands, roots or leaves.

title: Заморозка
motif: One bold six-armed snowflake, six thick spokes with one large fork at each tip. Strong symmetric snowflake silhouette, no crystalline faceting or center decoration.

title: Мокрота
motif: Exactly three separate simple solid water droplets arranged as one larger drop above two smaller drops. Preserve clear gaps, no highlights, no floor or waves.

title: Магический щит
motif: One broad protective magical dome surrounding a single small solid dot. The dome is an open-bottom thick semicircular arc with short vertical sides, not a physical kite shield. Only dome and dot.

title: Поднятый щит
motif: One large solid upright kite shield, broad squared shoulders, tapering to a sharp lower point. Plain flat filled shield silhouette. No emblem, cross, rivets or reflection.

title: Оппортунист
motif: One simple boot stepping to the right with one short broad dagger pointing at its heel from behind. Only boot and pursuing blade, no person, movement trails or ground.

title: Контратака
motif: One bold U-turn arrow curving back toward a short sword blade. Return strike symbol. Only broad hooked arrow and single blade, no hilt detailing or extra sparks.

title: Прикрытие
motif: Two plain overlapping kite shields, one larger foreground shield covering part of a smaller shield beside it. Distinct stepped double-shield outer contour. No people, emblems or rivets.

title: Ожидание
motif: One large solid hourglass silhouette, broad horizontal top and bottom, pinched narrow waist, two large triangular empty chambers. No sand grains, person or clock face.

title: Огонь на клетке
motif: One compact upright three-tongue flame rising from a broad flat diamond-shaped floor tile. Only flame and diamond base, no texture or coals. The diamond base must remain obvious.

title: Лужа кислоты
motif: One broad shallow horizontal puddle with irregular rounded edge and exactly one large round bubble above it. Low wide silhouette. No drop falling, hand, ground tile or splashes.

title: Шипы
motif: Exactly three tall broad triangular metal spikes rising from one short horizontal base, central spike tallest. No individual highlights, holes, springs or extra spikes.

title: Труп
motif: One simple human body lying horizontally on the ground: a large round head at left, thick horizontal torso, one visibly bent knee and one outstretched arm. Clear dead prone body silhouette, no skull close-up, bones, gore, armor or scenery.

title: Обвал
motif: One broad diamond floor slab broken by a single very wide zigzag crack from top to bottom, split into two visibly separated jagged halves. No debris, falling stones or fine cracks.

title: Ловушка на полу
motif: One broad diamond floor pressure plate with a single large raised circular button in its center. Only diamond and round button, thick clean outlines. No spikes, flame, teeth, gears or springs.

title: Ловушка в стене
motif: One thick short vertical wall bar at left, with one large horizontal arrow emerging toward the right. Large distinct arrowhead. Only wall and arrow, no brick pattern or projectile trail.

title: Глубокая кислота
motif: One raised hand sinking into a broad deep liquid wave: a simple palm with three broad finger tips above one thick horizontal wave. Distinct drowning-hand silhouette, no skull, bubbles, floor tile or extra objects.

title: Провал
motif: One low wide jagged hole in the floor, near-black filled center surrounded by a single thick pale irregular rim. Asymmetric broken opening silhouette, no eye, teeth, sparkles or floor texture.

title: Опасность
motif: One bold triangular warning sign with one large exclamation-shaped negative-space cutout. Simple three-corner silhouette, no base tile or decorative border.
